title: Grounded Cache Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: When Is It Safe to Reuse an Answer?
why_relevant: Proposes an evidence-validated cache router that gates cached answer reuse to prevent serving wrong/stale/adversarially hijacked answers, addressing safety, drift, and collision attacks in RAG. Introduces a stress-test workload and unsafe-served-rate metric tied to robustness evaluation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on the answer-caching layer rather than core retrieval/generation robustness; somewhat niche systems angle.
